{"outcome":"DIRECT_HIGH_QUALITY","best_model_id":"PGS000015","confidence":"Moderate","rationale":"Multiple direct-match candidates exist for the target trait (breast carcinoma) with trait_efo exactly matching breast carcinoma (e.g., PGS000001/004/007/015/028/029/072/332/335/783 and others).
